title: Implement the V4 P9.3 one-active-Target workspace and Stage Runner
goal: Add a Host-projected one-active-Target workspace and manual serialized Stage Runner to the local Web Companion without accepting browser paths, raw arguments or a second verdict authority.
acceptanceCriteria: Trusted startup arguments may register multiple Target roots, but browser selection uses only Host-derived project IDs and exactly one Target is active.
Installed Profile, module, Stage and prerequisite readiness comes from P9.2 Host query projections.
Manual Stage execution exposes its dependency chain, uses only constructed stage.run arguments and preserves the Host JSON and exit code.
Target switching and UI-originated runs are serialized, and simultaneous runs fail closed before a second Host Stage process starts.
Workspace, selection and Stage contracts are strict and reject path, command and profile injection.
Windows and pinned network-disabled Linux tests prove root confinement and one-active-Target behavior.
No P9.4/P9.5 feature, authority edit, Target mutation, reset, Git/PR action, remote access or remote activation is introduced.
